A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MOFFLOW-2 research and contain complete main texts and Appendices A–H. Extracted text, rendered pages, and embedded graphics support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original structure-prediction and generation experiments in Tables 2–3, plus property, conditional CO2-generation, and energy evaluations in Appendix G.

after.justification: v4 retains original experimental results in Tables 2–3 and the property, GCMC simulation, and energy evaluations in Appendix G.

M1.justification: The SMILES generator, building-block initialization, torsion-aware flow-matching model, canonicalization, and MOF matching are unchanged. The architecture and training/inference algorithms in Appendices C–E are retained.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Boyd et al. MOF data for structure prediction and generation, including the same conditional generation scenario targeting high CO2 working capacity in Appendix G.2.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains RS, EA, DiffCSP, and MOFFlow. Table 3 and the conditional-generation and energy comparisons retain MOFDiff. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The dataset splits, filtering, matching tolerances, prediction sample counts, 10,000-sample generation evaluations, and training/inference settings are unchanged (Section 6; Appendices A, D–G).

E4.justification: The metal-block variability analysis, property-distribution checks, energy analysis, and illustrative MOF examples are retained. No new ablation, robustness test, or analytical question is introduced.

E5.justification: Point estimates and kernel-density-based distribution reporting remain unchanged. v4 adds no run or seed disclosures, uncertainty intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Reported numbers and findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains MOFFLOW-2's five-sample MR of 43.95% at stol=0.5; Table 3 retains 38.84% validity, 31.35% VNU, and 10.10% NBB. Appendix results are unchanged, and Figure 5 reuses the same six embedded sample images.

T1.justification: The structural and manifold definitions, flow-matching objectives, and mathematical derivations in Equations 1–15 are retained. Equation placement and text wrapping change without altering the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: generating novel building blocks, modeling linker flexibility, improving structure prediction, and producing valid, novel, unique MOFs.

C2.justification: v4's conclusion summarizes RDKit dependence, partial property conditioning, and approximate energy evaluation. All three limitations already appeared in v2's Appendix H and remain there; the substantive interpretations and applicability boundaries are unchanged.

D1.justification: The code-access information, tokenization instructions, hyperparameter Tables 4–6, preprocessing procedures, hardware, training durations, and inference budgets are retained without substantive revisions.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and cited works are unchanged. Bibliography differences update citation-page backlinks following text reflow.

P1.justification: v4 updates author affiliation/contact information and acknowledgements, adds a short summary of existing limitations to Section 7, and makes limited wording edits. The section and appendix organization is retained.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is resized/repositioned with rewrapped surrounding text. Figure 5 has revised cropping and display of the same sample images. Page breaks and table placement shift, but no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 replaces the conclusion's bare pointer to Appendix H with a concise summary of the actual limitations, making applicability constraints more visible. This and modest figure/layout refinements provide a limited presentation improvement; the scientific evidence and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
